name: PD4
about: post-boot firmware-side H2D mailbox poller: redirect the boot-task success epilogue (CPU 0x4916A) onto a guarded out[0] poll stub parked in the all-zero static-data alignment gap CPU 0x108197..0x108413 (stub at CPU 0x108240); the stub waits for the hcc instance (CPU 0x10C190) to be initialised, polls mailbox out[0] (CA 0x40039010), and calls the firmware's own event-0x4C handler wrapper CPU 0x40294 -> H2D mailbox dispatcher CPU 0xC18AC. Reconstructed and independently verified by lane wifi-fw-audit; original design lane wifi-irq-unmask (task-100).

segments.role: PD4-ENTRY: boot-task success epilogue CPU 0x4916A ('movs r0,#0; add sp,#0x84') -> branch into the stub

segments.expect: ldr r7, [pc, #0x2c] ; sub sp, #4 ; ldr r3, [r7] ; cmp r3, #0 ; beq #0x108244 ; ldr r2, [pc, #0x28] ; ldr r3, [r2] ; cmp r3, #0 ; beq #0x108244 ; ldr r3, [r7, #0x14] ; ldr r4, [pc, #0x20] ; cmp r3, r4 ; beq #0x108260 ; bl #0x40294 ; b #0x108244 ; ldr r4, [pc, #0x18] ; str r4, [r7, #0x14] ; bl #0x40294 ; str r3, [r7, #0x14] ; b #0x108244 ; nop ; nop ; stm r1!, {r2, r3, r4, r7} ; movs r0, r2 ; str r0, [sp, #0x40] ; ands r3, r0 ; ldrh r0, [r5, #0x2a] ; movs r1, r2 ; movs r0, #0 ; movs r0, r0
segments.role: PD4-LOOP: guarded out[0] poll stub in the zero static-data gap (64 B incl. 16 B literal pool)

semantics.entry_site: boot-task success epilogue CPU 0x4916A (reached only after the full boot/init chain including pcie_msg_init)
semantics.loop_site: static-data alignment gap CPU 0x108197..0x108413; 637 B all-zero in the vendor image; outside both boot memsets and outside the exception-staging area
semantics.callee: CPU 0x40294: ldr r0,=0x0010C190 (hcc instance) ; b.w CPU 0xC18AC (H2D mailbox dispatcher)
semantics.stack: sub sp,#4 compensates the skipped add sp,#0x84 frame: 0x84+8*4 = 0xA4 == 4 (mod 8) before the public call, so the extra 4 B restores AAPCS 8-byte alignment

safety.note: the patched image is built locally from the reader's own vendor blob; this recipe carries offsets, source-window hashes and OUR patch bytes only
